integrity: Proof is self-contained; finite verifier is supporting evidence only. Bibliographic dates track earliest verified public versions, not journal publication dates.
scientific_limitations: Novelty concerns all-base threshold-heavy factor classification; the classical base-three prefix-normal and Abelian statements are pre-existing. Two-Abelian generalized-Cantor article full text was not available; exact maximal-weight factors at arbitrary lengths and other digit sets are outside scope.
title: Threshold-heavy factors in generalized Cantor words: a complete carry-free classification
